entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a pair of cycling shoes. I just need to know if it's approved so I can get the shipping label.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, is there a technical fault with the shoes or is it more of a preference issue?
Look, I don't have time to go through a dozen questions. They hurt my feet and are giving me blisters. Can I get a refund or not? It's a simple question.
I completely understand, apologies for the delay. I just need your order number to check the return eligibility in the system.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes, delivered on December 5th. Yes, you are well within our 90-day return period. I can approve this return for you right now.
Great. So you're sending the label?

Yes. And I see here you're a VIP member with us. I've gone ahead and processed a full refund immediately, so you don't have to wait for the item to return to our warehouse. I've also emailed you a prepaid return label. Just drop the package off at your convenience.
Oh. Okay, that's much better. I appreciate that. It's a shame, the cleats interface was perfect, but the fit just wasn't right and caused those blisters. I'll watch for that email.
I'm sorry they didn't work out, but I'm glad I could make the return process easy for you. The email has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
